allow:
Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command '
$adb = "adb"
$serial = if ($env:NVIM_ANDROID_SERIAL) { $env:NVIM_ANDROID_SERIAL } else { (& $adb devices | Select-String "^\S+\s+device$" | Select-Object -First 1).Line.Split()[0] }
$pkg = $env:NVIM_UE_ANDROID_PACKAGE
if (-not $serial) { throw "No Android device found" }
if (-not $pkg) { throw "Set NVIM_UE_ANDROID_PACKAGE first" }
& $adb -s $serial shell "run-as $pkg sh -c ''pkill -9 lldb-server 2>/dev/null''" 2>$null
$sockName = "lldb-platform-test"
$sockPrefix = "/data/data/$pkg/lldb"
$lldbCmd = "/data/data/$pkg/lldb/bin/lldb-server platform --server --listen unix-abstract://$sockPrefix/$sockName"
& $adb -s $serial shell "run-as $pkg sh -c ''nohup $lldbCmd </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &''"
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$lldbPid = \(& $adb -s $serial shell "run-as $pkg pidof lldb-server" 2>$null\).Trim\(\)
Write-Host "lldb-server pid=$lldbPid"
if \(-not $lldbPid\) { throw "lldb-server failed" }
$connectUri = "unix-abstract-connect://[$serial]$sockPrefix/$sockName"
Write-Host "connect_uri=$connectUri"
Write-Host "DONE"
' 2>&1)
